clips.title: The story
paras: A weathered note in the Barrens points travelers toward Stepping Stones, a mountain refuge near Desolace. It says two couriers made deliveries for the New Plague, and calls what happened to them simple apothecary accidents.

A torn message hangs from a wooden plank at a backcountry camp in the Barrens. Mercenaries, cutthroats, and drifters pass through such camps for brief shelter, far from the eyes of the Crossroads or Ratchet. Among the wilds' ordinary signs, the note offers a reason to look beyond the camp and toward the mountains.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The note begins, "Mission said they were both making deliveries for New Plague. Looks like simple apothecary accidents to me. Find my cozy spot in the mountains between The Barrens and Desolace if you want a safe place to talk."

clips.title: Completion
paras: Backcountry adventurers and mercenaries alike undoubtedly make camp here. The corner of a note flapping in the breeze catches your eye and you reach for it.
